parameters.name: perturbation_grid
parameters.unit: multiple of each feature's standard deviation
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: Noise scales for the perturbation robustness grid (06 C.7 l.1009-1012 gives the construction, no values).

parameters.name: perturbation_tolerance
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: Degradation of AUC tolerated at the preset scale 0.1; about 2.5 standard errors of an AUC on the Taiwan holdout (about 6,000 holdout rows).

parameters.name: n_seeds
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: Seeds of the seed sweep (06 I.1 l.1191 gives none); 20 gives a standard deviation of the AUC with a relative error near 16 percent.

parameters.name: n_bootstrap_refits
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: Refits of the reason-code stability (04 J.2 l.881-883 gives none).

parameters.name: overfit_tolerance
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: Train minus test AUC gap beyond which the overfit flag is raised (06 C.7 l.1016-1018 gives no value).

parameters.name: weak_spot_multiple
parameters.unit: multiple of the average test error
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: k: a slice is a weak spot when its test error exceeds k times the average (06 C.7 l.1016-1018).

parameters.name: shift_score
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: The shift score ranking subsamples; a classifier of development against evaluation rows (06 C.7 l.1048-1051 resemblance AUC).

parameters.name: worst_subsample_share
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: The dossier's example is the worst 10 percent (06 C.7 l.1013-1014).

parameters.name: decision_cutoff_reject_share
parameters.label: convention
parameters.basis: The cut-off is the baseline score quantile that declines this share; held fixed under every shift (decision Q10).

notice.en: Labelled evidence on the Taiwan model of this variant: gaps in error rates, calibration and AUC across sex, age band and marital status groups at a cut-off that declines 20 percent of the baseline decisions. It is a descriptive check on one benchmark, not a statement about any lender and not a compliance statement.
notice.es: Evidencia etiquetada sobre el modelo de Taiwan de esta variante: brechas de tasas de error, calibración y AUC entre grupos de sexo, tramo de edad y estado civil con un punto de corte que rechaza el 20 por ciento de las decisiones base. Es una verificación descriptiva sobre un benchmark, no una afirmación sobre ningún prestamista ni una declaración de cumplimiento.

title.en: Only the two boosted-tree rungs are swept: the others are deterministic given the data or have no TreeSHAP attribution
title.es: Solo se barren las dos etapas de árboles potenciados: las demás son deterministas dado los datos o no tienen atribución TreeSHAP

title.en: XGBoost computes in single precision, so the Shapley additivity gap of its rung is about 1e-6 and the engine's 1e-9 tolerance flags it; it is a precision remark on the arithmetic, not an error of the attributions
title.es: XGBoost calcula en precisión simple, de modo que la brecha de aditividad de Shapley de su etapa es cercana a 1e-6 y la tolerancia de 1e-9 del motor la señala; es una observación de precisión aritmética, no un error de las atribuciones

title.en: The number of boosting rounds is the one chosen on the first fit and is not re-chosen per seed, so the dispersion is the seed's effect with the model size held
title.es: El número de rondas se elige en el primer ajuste y no se reelige por semilla, de modo que la dispersión es el efecto de la semilla con el tamaño del modelo fijo
